events.text:
I traced this by hand and did not run it through a checker.

The door at (17,19) sits on a small island. The only gap to it is the water at (17,16), so a boulder has to be pushed south down column 17 until it sinks there. The trader pushes one thing at a time and can only push south from (17,11), a floor cell reachable only through (17,12). Boulder 1 can't be put at (17,12) with the trader already north of it, so the plan works around that:

1. **Bridge east with boulder 1.** Push boulder 1 east twice, from (15,12). It sinks at (18,12), which gives a walkable path to the east island.
2. **Move the mirror.** Walk to (21,13) and push the mirror north to (21,11).
3. **Position boulder 2.** Push boulder 2 west from (22,14) to (20,14). Push it north to (20,12), then west along row 12 to (17,12), standing on the sunk boulder at (18,12).
4. **Teleport to the plug position.** Walk to (21,15) and press `X`. The mirror's south face sees the trader at distance 4 and reflects it to (17,11). The path is clear and the end cell is empty.
5. **Finish.** Push south four times. Boulder 2 sinks at (17,16), and four more steps reach the door.
